action:
After a standard system update you need to restart PostSRSd to make all the
necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that PostSRSd incorrectly handled long timestamp tags in
SRS addresses. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause
PostSRSd to consume excessive CPU resources, leading to a denial of
service.
isummary:
PostSRSd could be made to consume excessive resources if it received
specially crafted network traffic.
